# agx

> Command-line toolkit for AI coding agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex): plan usage for every account at once, launch on the account with the most headroom, resume a conversation on the account that stores it, and manage session folders.

agx is open source (khanakia/agx), written in Go. It reads the logins the agent CLIs already stored and makes one read-only GET per account to the vendor's own usage endpoint (api.anthropic.com, chatgpt.com); tokens are never refreshed, written or printed, and there is no telemetry.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/khanakia/agx/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, usage, FAQ
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/khanakia/agx/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/khanakia/agx/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute

## Install
- Go: `go install github.com/khanakia/agx@latest`
